detail: For a QuantileFitError without partial_forecast, fit_diagnostics is list(error.diagnostics), retaining mapping keys rather than diagnostic values. The separately retained candidate.failure from original _failure(error) preserves allowed numeric diagnostics/context and code. COMPLETE candidate diagnostic lists are not affected. No failure refit-clock list is claimed complete from those key strings.
impact: No forecast arithmetic/selection/protocol change. Audit must check only actual retained fields. Occurrence counts require final saved-output audit; no rerun or live code modification authorized.
